definitions.explanation: A person who watches an event, performance, or unusual scene, typically out of curiosity rather than as a participant.

examples.japanese: {見物人|けんぶつにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見物人|けんぶつにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There were many onlookers at the fire scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見物人|けんぶつにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{眺|なが}めていた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: Spectators watched the festival procession from both sides of the street.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{見物|けんぶつ}→見物：01398_kenbutsu⟧ (watching, sightseeing) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). Refers to someone watching an event or spectacle, often as a casual or curious bystander rather than an invited guest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見物人|けんぶつにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: onlookers gather
- ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見物人|けんぶつにん}: a large crowd of spectators
- {見物人|けんぶつにん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわう: to be lively with spectators

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧: audience — people who attend a performance or game, often with tickets
- ⟦{野次馬|やじうま}→野次馬：16403_yajiuma⟧: rubberneckers — onlookers who gather purely out of idle curiosity, with a negative nuance
